answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own thread record, and its own share of the inlet quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The vertex ledger enforces the limit at intake. The nonce chain allows at most 3 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 847 identities would post 4584 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
